title: Search for Phenotype-modifying Genes in Patients With Intellectual Disabilities.
official: Search for Phenotype-modifying Genes in Patients With Intellectual Disabilities GWAS-2DI.
summary: Each form of intellectual disability under study is a rare disease in its own right, and it is therefore difficult to study the variability of its expression. It therefore appears necessary to study large series of patients with intellectual disabilities. The objective is to identify variants in phenotype-modifying genes in patients with intellectual disability.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with Intellectual Disability or related but not affected by them
* Major or minor with autorisation of legal representative
* Exome sequencing in Bordeaux University Hospital between 2018 and 2024

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate in research protocols
* Refusal to participate expressed following receipt of information letter.
